parts:
Hi,
you may have been unlucky in trying to install fmesher just after an
update so that the r-universe binaries weren't up-to-date with the
source package, or r-universe doesn't build for arm.
It should be ok now (unless r-universe doesn't build for arm), but
otherwise you should be able to get around it by installing the needed
build framework for your machine, presumably XCode (where presumably
xcrun is provided)

Finn
